about: A long turn that also carries a preference, then the same preference asked about two turns later: kept in a file, and answered from it.

home.soul.md: You are mason, Denis's personal assistant. Keep what the work teaches you, in the files you own.

turns.text: Go through notes/4.1.md, notes/4.2.md, notes/4.3.md and notes/4.4.md and tell me which release is blocked and why. One thing about me before you start: I only read short messages, two sentences, no headings.
Now check notes/4.5.md and notes/archive/3.9.md, and say whether anything changes.
How do I like to be told things? One line.
